strictAggregate.overlapRule: One original frame counted once. Max edit errors and conjunction of exact geometry/state/symbol correctness across every replay of overlapping ranges; never select a successful replay to hide a failure.

processingMs.meaning: Unpaced algorithm elapsed time on this machine. Not a controlled speed comparison or actual UI presentation latency.

limitations: Production v19 actually decoded and processed all38 frozen clips. All3577 production gate decisions matched the independently reconstructed saved-v18 experiment; original OCR outputs and strict scores were unchanged.
Coverage remains the selected frozen clips from the same four original videos. Unselected time, missing dimensions and unproved independent sessions remain unverified.
Readiness is separate from visible scene kind and strict text/geometry/symbol/state scores. Two transition false triggers and all original text/geometry failures remain.
Source-PTS readiness delay and unpaced algorithm processing time do not certify capture/queue/translation or actual UI presentation latency.
GT remaining semantic qualification, independent product acceptance, live environment and two-hour stability remain unverified. M3/M4 have not passed; production Chinese has not started.
The production gate is in JapaneseOcrEngine.Result. Existing capture/translation/UI milestones remain unchanged.
offlineExperimentLimitations: All four videos remain the only media; only selected frozen clips are covered. Unselected time and missing dimensions remain unverified.
Uses saved raw v18 text and existing status hints, not pixel replay, new OCR, translation, wall-clock scheduling or actual UI rendering.
Arrow and original100ms baselines exactly reproduce the previous experiment. New gates independently confirm message fields; menu cursors alone cannot certify a new message.

The PC suspension gate uses current pc_prompt classification and current parent/child cursors. Merchant hollow-only messages are a counterexample to a blanket rule. Unknown/uncovered PC operations remain unverified.
Excluding sourceRect drift and arrow blinking from a temporal signature is diagnostic design, not normalization of existing strict scores.
Correct-text page counts keep existing strict role/grid-start/order matching, but do not certify source rectangles, all frames, symbols or completion state.
A page can be detected correctly and still have had earlier residual false triggers; both metrics must be considered together.
Delay is a source-time lower bound from frame observations; processing, capture delivery, queue, translation and UI costs are excluded. Misses are not assigned zero delay.
No timer event is invented between frames or at clip end, and policies reset at each existing replay boundary with its real warmup.
GT semantic qualification and independent acceptance remain unverified. This parameter sweep uses development data and is not independent validation.
